<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex012012026-06-2212-48-09" status="unreviewed">gzhan yang <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3840">dan phag</rs> na re dgos pa de 'dod bya yin pa nying dgos gya nom pa 'byung ba la rag las pa la dgongs pa'o ||
            mdzes pa las 'jug go zhe na ma yin te| brjod bya dang dgos pa dang nying dgos med na gzhung mdzes kyang mi 'jug la| dgos pa dang nying dgos yod na mi mdzes kyang 'jug pa rtogs ldan gyi lugs yin no || 
               mchod brjod ngag las kyang mdzes par 'grub na mdzes pas|_dgos 'brel gyi ngag gi 'bras [MSb_x]bu ma yin par thal te|_ldog pa ma grub pa'i phyir ro || 
               'dod na rgyu 'bras 'brel ba med na|_tha dad pa dang bdag gcig pa'i 'brel pa de bas kyang med pas|_gzhung mdzes pa dang dgos 'brel 'brel ba gtan med du 'gyur ro || 
               de'ang 'dod na dgos 'brel ngag gis dgos pa de sgrub mi nus par 'gyur [MSb_x]7te|_'brel ba gang yang med pa'i phyir ro || 
               khyab pa med na|_mi la phyug ni bdog gam ci ste|_de bzhin rta yang bdog gam ci ste yod par thal lo|_
               'dod na mdzes pa dgos pa yin pa nyam pas so [)]ro || 
            grangs nges pa 'ang [(]pa'ang [)]mi 'grub ste ngag bzhi' kho na bkod pas gzhung [MSb_x][%= ]mdzes pa ma yin pa'i phyir ro || </seg></TEI>
